description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of cards in your library.
Cast Disciple of Bolas by paying {3}{B}.
Disciple of Bolas enters the battlefield, sacrificing the Fractal and causing you to gain life and draw cards equal to the Fractal's power.
